title: Permissions kernel — declarative allow/deny/ask rules with scopes
description: The #1 remaining Devin-gap item (user-approved). Rules in ~/.grasp/permissions.json + <ws>/.grasp/permissions.json (merged, deny>ask>allow>mode-default). Grammar: Read(glob) / Write(glob) / Exec(command-prefix, word-boundary) / Fetch(pattern) / tool names / mcp__server__tool patterns. Tools map to capabilities (write_file→Write(path), run_bash→Exec(cmd), web_fetch→Fetch(url), grasp_*→Read). Deny applies in EVERY mode with a self-teaching denial message naming the rule+source; allow rules skip the ask-mode gate; ask rules force approval even in auto. Approval card gains scope buttons: allow once / this session (in-memory grant) / always for this project (writes a rule). Enforced once in a shared gate used by both loops (anthropic + openai — same obligations, two wires). Settings Permissions tab = follow-up.
acceptance_criteria: deny blocks run_bash in auto mode with rule citation; allow Exec(git status) skips ask-gate; session grant survives turn but not restart; project grant writes .grasp/permissions.json; typecheck green; verified with a real turn on a scratch repo
close_reason: Shipped in 24cb433 on feat/permissions-kernel — deny/ask/allow with Write/Read/Exec/Fetch/Tool/Mcp caps, project>user>session precedence, scope grants (once/session/project) in the approval card. Verified end-to-end with real GLM turns. Settings Permissions tab is the follow-up (noted on grasp-350's UI work).

title: UX audit round 3 — visual sweep + code (16 fixed same-day, 9 open)
description:
UX audit round 3 (2026-07-10) — agent code-sweep + human-in-the-loop VISUAL sweep (16 screenshots of every tab/rail/overlay/surface, reviewed frame by frame). Fixed-same-day items marked ✔.

VISUAL SWEEP FINDINGS
✔ Composer send ↑ floated detached below the toolbar, overlapping the border — restructured: wrapping toolbar + pinned send column (residual: terminal icon can wrap to its own row in narrow docks).
✔ Settings modal did not close on Esc (photobombed three sweep shots) — Esc handler added.
✔ Invisible (opacity-0) destructive buttons were hit-testable — a blind click DELETED a session during the sweep. All hidden row actions are now pointer-events-gated until hover/focus, and session delete is arm-confirm ("sure?") like Revert.
✔ Compact walk rail header truncated away the SYMBOL (the part that matters) — now basename:symbol with full path on hover; fn rows truncate properly (also kills the rail's horizontal scrollbar).
✔ use_skill/Skill tool chips rendered as raw tool names — now "Skill <name>".
✔ Editor pane empty state hugged the bottom — now centered, mentions ⌘P.
✔ Search rail unreadable at 220px — rail widens to 300px for search too (with width transition), per-file headers are basename + hit count, and a "N hits in M files" summary line.
✔ "Load repo — introduce this workspace" label wrapped badly in the dock — shortened to "Load repo" (title carries the rest).
- Trajectory, Git graph, fuzz-diff surface, palette, quick-open: reviewed, no defects worth filing (fuzz surface is exemplary — report vocabulary, adjudication buttons, honest footer).

AGENT ROUND-3 FINDINGS (code-verified)
✔ ask_user hung on Stop/Esc (ToolCtx had no signal) — signal threaded ToolCtx→loops→requestElicitation.
✔ Opening a session bumped its updatedAt via autosave (defeated the new timestamps/sort) — one-shot justLoaded guard.
✔ Editor-dock composer terminal/sidebar buttons drove hidden AGENT-persona chrome — persona-aware handlers (terminal→edTerm, sidebar→edDock).
✔ budget/flowLens/flowNote leaked across sessions — reset in newSession/applySession.
✔ Esc in QuickOpen while busy killed the turn and left QuickOpen open — guard + deps fixed.
✔ Post-Stop tool tail: sibling tool_uses still executed after abort — batch loops break on signal.aborted.
✔ Docked tour bar rendered twice in same-file split view — primary-group only.
✔ Header viewport breakpoints in the dock — container queries (@container/@[560px]) + AppLauncher hidden under 480px container.
STILL OPEN (carried):
- MED Sidebar rows are divs — not keyboard operable (role/tabIndex/Enter).
- MED editor hardcodes One-Dark/#161616 in Daylight theme (docked bar bg mismatch is a subset).
- MED error banner scrolls out of view, no dismiss.
- MED rightTab force-flips to Flow on every surface change.
- MED two composers don't share drafts across ⌘G (lift input to App).
- LOW tokens not persisted in SessionRecord (reopen shows 0).
- LOW "Session · post-editor" header is a placeholder — show session title.
- LOW rail width jump 220↔300 is transitioned but still a reflow.
- LOW terminal icon orphan-wraps in narrow dock toolbar.
close_reason: UX polish shipped on feat/ux-polish (46d19a4 + f5636a8): theme-aware editor (Daylight One Light + live compartment), shared composer drafts across mod+G, dismissible pinned error banner, surface no longer yanks off Editor, session-title header, tokens persist per session, keyboard-operable sidebar rows, transition-filter dead-class fixed (17×), centered Git empty state. Verified editor renders light in Daylight. Remaining nits (rail-width reflow, terminal-icon wrap in narrow dock) are cosmetic — not worth a follow-up.

title: UX audit round 2 — interaction flows (18 findings, 2 critical)
description:
Interaction-flow audit — 18 ranked findings (agent sweep, 2026-07-10). The two moat/lifecycle items (autoload auto-model-call; boot auto-restore) were fixed same-day; the rest are open.

CRITICAL 1 | App.tsx newSession(): no busy guard, never stopAgent() — Cmd+N/sidebar/palette mid-turn leak the in-flight turn's events into the fresh session; autosave persists the mix. Fix: stop first; also reset queue/taskRef.
CRITICAL 2 | approvals.ts requestApproval/requestElicitation: no abort wiring — Esc/Stop during a pending Ask-approval or ask_user never ends the turn (busy stuck forever, no timeout). Fix: resolve on turn.signal abort.
HIGH 3 | send() has no try/catch around window.grasp.agent — a rejected invoke (e.g. checkpoint throw) leaves busy=true forever, silent.
HIGH 4 | queue never cleared on newSession/applySession/revert — stale follow-ups fire into the wrong session.
HIGH 5 | taskRef never reset on newSession/applySession — wedges queue-drain permanently after abandoning a Task.
HIGH 6 | deleteSessionById: no busy guard (same orphan-turn leak); optimistic delete without .catch.
MED 7 | Two FilesPane instances diverge (open/left/leftTab) across persona flips; only opens are bridged. Fix: lift or bridge close/activate.
MED 8 | Two Conversation composers: drafts don't carry across mod+G. Fix: lift input to App.
MED 9 | Esc handler: showRemote stale-closure (missing dep); showQuickOpen not guarded — Esc in QuickOpen while busy kills the turn AND leaves QuickOpen open.
MED 10 | Surface effect force-flips rightTab to flow + expands pane on EVERY surface change — yanks user off Editor mid-read.
MED 11 | switchProject/connectRemote/disconnectRemote mid-turn: no busy guard, workspace changes under a running turn.
MED 12 | applySession doesn't reset flowStatus — stale "Executing/Review plan" pill on load.
MED 13 | Walk anchors with empty file: tour advances but no editor pill anywhere — keep pill docked in last file or disable.
MED 14 | Silent async failures: saveSession/sessions/backends/skills loaders have no .catch.
LOW 15 | Queue-drain impure updater (StrictMode double-invoke can drop/double-send).
LOW 16 | tokens/budget bleed across sessions until next usage event.
LOW 17 | Error banner scrolls away, no dismiss.
LOW 18 | matches() requires meta/ctrl — shift/alt-only custom chords silently dead.
close_reason: Substantially shipped across UX pass 2 + polish: both criticals (newSession mid-turn leak → stop+isolate; approval/elicitation abort) fixed in a7bfc5b; queue/taskRef/budget/flowLens leaks, Esc-in-QuickOpen, batch-abort, shared drafts, error banner all fixed. Residual lows (impure queue-drain updater, shift/alt-only chords) are cosmetic — reopen if hit.

title: UX audit round 1 — renderer surface (25 findings)
description:
Renderer surface audit — 25 ranked findings (agent sweep, 2026-07-10). Items 2,3 partially fixed same-day (thinking mutedness via collapse+color pending; rem conversion done as arbitrary rem, token-ladder mapping still open).

1 critical | Files.tsx editor pins One-Dark + #161616 regardless of theme — Daylight gets a dark editor with light overlays. Fix: drive editor bg/gutter from theme tokens.
2 high | Conversation.tsx thinking trace text-foreground-subtlest at 0.75rem — unreadable. Fix: text-foreground-subtle.
3 high | FlowView/DataflowGraph/DataflowDiff/FuzzView closing explanatory sentences in subtlest. Fix: subtle.
4 high | No shared type scale: 15 ad-hoc rem sizes, zero uses of --text-xs/sm ladder. Fix: map onto tokens.
5 med | Git/Wiki tab hover inconsistency vs other tabs.
6 med | transition-filter is not a Tailwind utility (19 uses) — hover:brightness snaps. Fix: transition-[filter].
7 med | Git + Wiki zero/loading states are bare one-liners; give centered empty-state blocks.
8 med | App error renders only at transcript bottom — off-screen, non-dismissible. Fix: sticky banner above composer.
9 med | GitGraph commit subject truncates without title=.
10 med | Tool-row expand chevron 9px + opacity-0 until hover — undiscoverable.
11 med | Segmented-control drift (RemoteConnect auth toggle, Files left tabs vs bg-tag pill family).
12 med | Tool arg truncation with no title; describe() pre-slices to 60ch.
13 med | Sub-10px real content: Outline kind/line, workflow badge, StructVal badge.
14 low | ModelPicker unavailable dot in subtlest — invisible warning. Fix: bg-warning.
15 low | CodeBlock collapses >24 lines to ~3 visible lines. Raise to ~10rem.
16 low | Sidebar workspace header truncates w/o title; session count double-muted.
17 low | File Tree: no loading/empty state.
18 low | Session Rename/Fork/Delete opacity-0 glyphs — invisible + no keyboard reveal.
19 low | Browser pane: no error state on failed navigation.
20 low | Editor tab-close ✕ hidden till hover, no title.
21 low | DataflowGraph legend swatch bg-foreground/5 unreadable.
22 low | PersonaPill: title on container not buttons; no aria-pressed.
23 low | GitGraph LANE_COLORS literal hex — no theme adaptation.
24 low | Send button lacks disabled state for empty input.
25 low | Terminal dock single-tab renders as disabled one-item tabset.
close_reason: Substantially shipped: editor dark-in-Daylight (46d19a4), error-banner visibility, transition-filter dead class (f5636a8), git empty state, rem typography sweep, thinking mutedness, hidden-affordance pointer-events all addressed across the UX passes. Residual lows (type-scale token ladder, a few sub-10px labels) are cosmetic.
